brief: GS Prime Services weekly flow report for Sep 18-24. Equity Fundamental L/S funds returned +0.90% (vs MSCI World +0.16%), driven by short-side alpha of +0.57% plus beta of +0.33%. Systematic L/S funds fell -0.33%, driven by long-side alpha losses of -0.23% plus beta of -0.10%. Overall book gross leverage fell 1.2pts to 308.0% (57th percentile 1-year) and net leverage fell 0.2pts to 77.3% (30th percentile), while the L/S ratio rose to 1.671. Global equities were net sold for the first time in 5 weeks, short sales outpacing long sales 1.6-to-1, led by North America and EM Asia, with 7 of 11 global sectors net sold. Industrials saw the largest percentage net selling in 3 months, driven entirely by short sales (4.5-to-1), while the book's Industrials overweight vs MSCI World stands at 3.8%. Financials was the most net-bought European sector in 6 months, long buys outpacing shorts 6.8-to-1, even as the book remains underweight Financials vs MSCI Europe by 6.0% after reaching 5-year lows the prior week.
